description.text:
在历史上的大部分时间里，加塔尔山麓都居住着数十个小「城邦」，它们通常只是坚固的城镇。他们耕种谷物、放牧绵羊或科塔孔普，大多喜欢自相残杀，自然也经常受到更大、更有野心的军阀或城市的影响，其中最重要的就是瓦奥卡努尔（中间道路）城。瓦奥卡努尔城位于韦斯雷努南部，曾是下加拉文德地区一座极其重要的城市，是几个地方军阀王国的首都。

虽然这座城市在约丹灭亡后的几年里达到了权力的顶峰，但在那之后，它又在不同的时期场合征服加拉文德的大片土地——往往是利用帝国或其他大国崩溃的机会。瓦奥卡努尔的军阀们骁勇善战、残酷无情，常常令人生畏，但这并没有阻止这座城市在与「风暴使者」卡德拉达的战争中被夷为平地。战争结束后，瓦奥卡努尔很快就得到了重建，但在随后的辰迪亚入侵中却未能幸免。如今，曾经引以为傲的瓦奥卡努尔城在韦斯雷努人的势力范围内已只剩下一座城墙，韦斯雷努人仍在缅怀它的历史，加拉文德的其他地区也依旧记得它的强大。
description.text_en:
For most of their history, the foothills of the Katalmarai were populated by scores of minor "city" states, often little more than fortified towns. Farming grain and herding sheep or kotakompu, they largely preferred to fight amongst themselves, naturally often falling under the influence of a larger, more ambitious warlord or city – the city of Vaokanur ("the middle road") paramount among them. Situated south of Uesrennu, it was once an extremely important city in the lower Kalavend, serving as the capital of several local warlord kingdoms.

Though the city reached the apex of its power in the years after the fall of Yodhan, it would conquer great swathes of the Kalavend on various occasions after that, often capitalising on the collapse of an empire or other great state. Bellicose and cruel, the warlords of Vaokanur were often feared, but that did not stop the city from being razed to the ground in the war against Kadradar the Stormbringer. While it would be rebuilt soon after the war’s end, it would not survive the subsequent Chendhyan invasions. Today, the once proud city of Vaokanur is little more than a walled town within the influence of the Uesrenni, who still call back to its legacy – while the rest of the Kalavendhi still remembers its strength.

name.text: 在瓦奥卡努尔废墟之上

description.text:
加塔尔山沿线的各种梯田农业村庄城市虽然数量众多、人口稠密，但一般都被视为加拉文德的贫民窟，有的被视为不相干的角色，有的只是瓦奥卡努尔剑下的绊脚石。尽管卡耶姆克的青金石非常珍贵，但没有任何一个军阀会认真地投资于这座出产青金石的城市。除了戈皮拉第二帝国。

他们看到了山下的潜力——不仅仅是山坡上的潜力——在他们统治的一个世纪里，他们将成千上万的奴隶投入到加塔尔山，挥舞着鞭子建设、开发和扩大该地区的地下财富。韦斯雷努是最大的受益者，它从一个洞穴入口处的小村庄变成了一座庞大的地下城市，矿井和隧道蜿蜒伸入群山深处。这座城市的领主们并没有忘记他们的起源，每年都有成千上万来自安得俄斯各地的奴隶进入阿里亚孔普的矿井。
description.text_en:
The various terrace-farming village-cities along the Katalmarai, though numerous and populous, were generally seen as the backwater of the Kalavend, variously dismissed as irrelevant actors or as the mere weight behind Vaokanur’s sword. Most empires who came into possession of the area saw little need to do more than collect tax and tribute, and though the lapis of Caiaymkq was highly prized, no warlord made any serious attempt to invest in the city that produced it. The Second Gophiran Empire was different.

Seeing the potential beneath the mountains – not just on their slopes – over their century of rule, they poured hundreds of thousands of slaves into the Katalmarai, the crack of the whip building, exploiting and expanding upon the subterranean wealth of the area. Nowhere benefited more from this than Uesrennu, which went from a small village at the entrance to a cavern to a massive subterranean city, with mines and tunnels snaking deep into the mountains. The lords of this city have not forgotten their origins, with thousands of slaves from across Andeios entering the mines of the Aryakompu every year.

name.text_en: Crack of the Whip, Crack of the Rock

description.text:
科塔孔普是一种啮齿类动物，体型与小型狼相当，长着镰刀状的牙齿，感官敏锐，身体粗壮，毛发稀疏，在整个泰琴德都很有名。狩猎它们是为了运动或吃肉，饲养它们是为了战争或采矿，它们已成为泰琴德地区最常见的驯养动物之一，这得益于它们独特的社会性，因为它们被组织成「女王国」，繁殖的科塔孔普王后得到工科塔孔普和兵科塔孔普的支持。饲养员和驯兽师必须与这些王后保持良好的关系，用食物和良好的条件来安抚它们——如果得到足够的满足，这些被驯化的王后就会心甘情愿地放弃自己的部分后代。

在戈皮拉人扩张之前，韦斯雷努人已经习惯了饲养这些动物，在加塔尔山深处使用它们也是理所当然的，但没想到的是，他们会在多大程度上与这些动物结成伙伴。在数以百计的驯化女王的控制下，韦斯雷努在戈菲尔帝国衰落的日子里，凭借他们成千上万的战争科塔孔普的力量获得了独立，从那时起，他们就把这些野兽当作伙伴和同类来珍视。
description.text_en:
The Kotakompu – rodents the size of small wolves, with sickle-tusk teeth, acute senses, hulking bodies and sparse hair – are well known throughout Taychend. Hunted for sport or meat, raised for war or for their usefulness in mining, they have become one of the most commonly domesticated animals in the regions below Taychend, aided by their uniquely social nature, organised as they are into "queendoms", with the breeding Kotakompu queens being supported by workers and soldiers. Breeders and trainers must maintain a good relationship with these queens, placating them with food and good conditions – if satisfied enough, these domesticated queens will willingly give up part of their own offspring.

Already accustomed to the practice of raising these animals before the Gophiran expansion, it was only natural that the people of Uesrennu would use them in the depths of the Katalmarai – what was not expected was the extent to which they would come to partner with them. With hundreds of domesticated queens under their control, Uesrennu would gain its independence in the waning days of the Gophiran Empire through the strength of their war-kotakompu, many thousands in number, and they have treasured the beasts as companions and kindred spirits ever since.

name.text: 一个达瓦纳，五百个王后

description.text: 在安得俄斯，青金石只有在凯亚姆克镇的地下才能找到，该镇位于文图卡马拉伊（未攻克之山）山脚下，这座大山阻挡了通往伊菲莱的通道。青金石磨成细粉后，会产生开达诺以外最绚丽的蓝色颜料——泰琴德遗迹精灵将这种物质称为「Ennunym」（字面意思为「矿蓝」），而坎诺人则将其称为群青。这种颜料因其美观的特性而在泰琴德备受推崇，它似乎还具有一种神奇的魔力，能让看到它的人产生「着迷」的效果——这也是泰琴德遗迹精灵不惜花费巨资采购它的原因。虽然目前还不知道是什么赋予了矿蓝这种特质，但人们怀疑是文图卡玛拉伊的某种魔力源造成的——-鉴于其地下采矿作业的不断扩大，很可能有一天会发现这种魔力源。
description.text_en: In Andeios, lapis lazuli is found only beneath the town of Caiyamkq, situated at the foothills of the Vintukkamarai – the untaken mountain – a large mountain that blocks the passage to the Effelai. When ground into a fine powder, Lapis produces the most brilliant blue pigment outside the Kaydano – a substance known to the Taychendi as Ennunym (literally "mined-blue"), but to Cannorians as Ultramarine. Highly prized throughout Taychend for its aesthetic properties, it also seems to have the magical quality of quite literally exuding an "enchanting" effect on those who look upon it – all the more reason for the expense the Taychendi go to procure it. Though it is unknown what gives Ennunym this quality, it is suspected that some source of magical power within Vintukkamarai is the culprit – and given the ever expanding mining operations beneath it, it is likely that one day that source may be uncovered.

description.text: 阿里亚孔普的创始人，「铜生咬合者」瓦拉姆日尔是韦斯雷努最成功的科塔孔普驯兽师，他对自己驯养的王后就像对自己的亲人一样。他骑着成千上万的科塔孔普兽推翻了戈皮拉人的驻军，把它们的尸体——甚至是还能动的——喂给了那些应得的科塔孔普。阿里亚孔普不仅统治着科塔孔普，他们还与科塔孔普一起出生，被科塔孔普塑造。他们拥有最危险的战争科塔孔普的凶猛，最有威严的女王的骄傲和目标，以及最能干的工人的勤奋和洞察力。凭借这种力量，阿里亚孔普赢得了无数的胜利，从反抗大纳加尔到1300年代中期在其本土山麓之外建立了一个相当大的王国。毋庸置疑，他的后代完全继承了其创始人的名声——以兽性残忍和凶残而闻名整个泰琴德。
description.text_en: The founder of the Aryakompu, Varamzhil the Copper-Born-Biter, was the most successful Kotakompu trainer in Uesrennu, speaking to his domesticated queens as if they were his own kin. On the backs of thousands of these beasts, he overthrew the Gophiran garrison, feeding their bodies – even the ones still moving – to those who were so deserving. The Aryakompu do not just rule over the Kompu, they were born with them, moulded by them. They match the ferocity of the most dangerous of their war-kompu, the pride and purpose of the most regal queens, and the diligence and perception of the most adept workers. Off the back of this strength, the Aryakompu have won countless victories, from their defiance of Nanru Nakar to the creation of a sizable kingdom beyond their native foothills in the mid 1300s. Needless to say, his descendants live up their founder’s reputation wholeheartedly – a reputation for bestial cruelty and ferocity that is known throughout Taychend.

description.text:
维伦纳尔·自由之剑这个名字在泰琴德家喻户晓，从奇莱马塔尔的奴隶囚笼到韦斯雷努的矿井。作为奴隶主的克星，维伦纳尔在泰琴德各地战斗、杀戮、解放，他坚信他的故乡阿哈塔迪亚姆的精灵们终有一天会归来，将泰琴德人民从奴役中解放出来。他建立了一个组织，在他死后很快就成为了维伦纳尔崇拜——致力于守护和培育希望之火，尽管、泰琴德的奴隶主势力对其进行了无情的迫害。

当太阳精灵来到南埃兰提尔，耳边传来他们驱逐黑暗、解放奴隶的信念时，维伦纳尔崇拜听到了他们所需要的一切。很显然，苏雷尔——独一烈阳——是最后一个难以捉摸的存在，太阳精灵的到来将预示着期待已久的世界变革——尽管正如加特尔贝赖之祸所证明的那样，他们并不是变革的推动者。韦斯雷努深处的独阳据点将被证明是这一信仰跳动的心脏，卡瓦拉尔（通常被翻译为「守望者」的战士祭司群体）所宣布的诏书在1500年代塑造并引导着这一不断扩大的运动。
description.text_en:
Vherenar Freesword is a name known throughout Taychend, from the chattel cages of Clemetar to the mines of Uesrennu. The slavers’ bane, Vherenar fought, killed and liberated across Taychend, holding fast to his belief in the Elusive Ones of his homeland, Ahartadyam, whom he believed would one day return to free the people of Taychend from slavery. He founded an organisation – that would quickly become the Cult of Vherenar after his death – dedicated to guarding and cultivating that flame of hope, despite relentless persecution by the slaver powers of Taychend.

When the Sun Elves arrived in South Aelantir, and whispers emerged of their beliefs in the banishment of darkness and the emancipation of slaves, the Cult of Vherenar heard all they needed. It was clear that Surael – the Oren Nayiru, or One Sun – was the last of the Elusive Ones, and that the arrival of the Sun Elves would herald in the long awaited transformation of the world – even if, as the Scouring of Katelperai proved, they would not be the agents of that change. The Oren Nayiru stronghold in the depths of Uesrennu would prove to be the beating heart of the faith, with the edicts proclaimed by the Kavalali, a class of warrior priests usually translated as "watchmen", shaping and guiding the ever-expanding movement in the 1500s.

description.text: 当埃兰达尔「银怨」——传奇的约丹盔甲的持有者——在泰琴德各地的卡瓦拉尔们史无前例的会议上发表讲话，号召开始一场盛大的起义，推翻压迫他们的军阀和刻伊俄奈殖民者时，来自韦斯雷努的卡瓦拉尔是他最狂热的支持者之一。对他们来说，新任命的「Kamrayakval」（通用语中的大哨兵）代表着一个世纪斗争的顶点——旧秩序即将终结。他们错了，数百万泰琴德遗迹精灵为此付出了代价。大哨兵死后，他的军队崩溃了，黑暗势力降临到了韦斯雷努。大部分人被杀，剩下的大部分人被奴役，遭受各种残暴和残酷的对待。但人们的精神没有崩溃，没有动摇。即使在几个世纪之后，独阳信徒在奇莱马塔尔的阴影下依然坚强不屈，他们的信徒时刻准备着再次站起来，将独阳之光传播到泰琴德和更远的地方。
description.text_en: When Elrandar Silverspite, wielder of the legendary armour of Yodhan, addressed an unprecedented meeting of Kavalali from across Taychend calling for the beginning of a grand uprising to depose the warlords and Kheionai colonisers oppressing them, those from Uesrennu were among his most fervent supporters. To them, the newly-appointed "Kamrayakval" (Grand Sentinel in common) represented the culmination of a century of struggle – the imminent end of the old order. They were wrong, and millions of Taychendi paid the price. After the Kamrayakval’s death, and the collapse of his armies, the forces of darkness descended on Uesrennu. Much of the population were killed, most of the rest enslaved, subject to all manner of brutality and cruelty. But the spirit of the people did not break, did not falter. Even centuries afterwards, the Oren Nayiru would remain strong in the shadow of the Katalmarai, its faithful always ready to rise once more and spread the light of Oren to Taychend and beyond.

player_overview.avoid_if: 奴役和暴力是本地剧情明确写出的统治基础。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 扩张、仪式与供养鼠群相互连接，而不是普通军事奖励叠加。 鼠王存活旗标实际改变军备、仪式与王朝任务条件。 覆灭事件是一段固定剧情转折；形成后的任务适用范围另外核对。
player_overview.overview: 韦斯雷努不是“反抗奴役然后获得自由”的单向英雄故事。它的祖先曾是反抗者，后来成为支配鼠群和矿城的王；1444的王朝则生活在奴隶劳动与恐惧维系的秩序中。你会扩张、供养鼠群、推进仪式，并经历王朝与信仰的剧烈转折。它的任务数量不算庞大，却以非常集中的黑暗剧情留下记忆，适合愿意接受主角并非好人的玩家。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢黑暗王朝、仪式和固定剧情转折的玩家。

positive_indicators: 有历史反奴役背景，但不抵消当前奴役
国家经营与防御不等于普遍民生改善
values.rationale: 本地鼠群呼唤叙事明确描述矿城奴隶劳动、鼠王后裔统治及以恐惧维持秩序，价值分与泰琴德22接近。原祖先反抗奴役不抵消后来的奴隶主制度；国家扩张本身不扣分。覆灭阶段涉及多方屠杀，不能因推翻鼠王便直接评分为善良新国；新制度缺证，不捏造救赎阶段。
red_flags: 矿城奴役劳动与恐惧统治
王朝崩塌包含严重政治暴力
